name: Wispuff
look: a ghostly plume of soft grey-white smoke puffs with a faint sleepy face and trailing smoke ribbons
entry: It clings to curtains and clothing long after leaving a room. You can always tell when a Wispuff has passed through by the stale chill in the air.
how: Wild: common in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
Its ability Lingering Scent leaves a haze for 3 turns after it faints that hurts non-Ghost Pokémon.
